entities.summary: Alphons Blasius Egli colloquially Alphons Egli was a Swiss attorney and politician who most notably served on the Federal Council (Switzerland) between 1983 and 1987 and as President of the Swiss Confederation in 1986 for the Christian Democratic People's Party.
